description: Read one payout run with its Stripe transfers: each transfer's status (pending, processing, paid, waiting for a retry, or failed), attempts, last error, next retry time, Stripe transfer id and idempotency key. Answers 404 while payout runs are not switched on for your workspace (list_payout_runs says so in execution.enabled). Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

run_id.description: The payout run: id on a list_payout_runs or request_payout_run result.

name: get_payout_run
